messages:
pm_julia: FYI BridgeFlow (Enterprise) is seeing a spike in 5xx + timeouts starting 09:20 UTC. CS flagged SLO risk for the last 30m. Escalating to eng-platform — need owners and an immediate mitigation plan.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2147, priority: P1. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bridgeflow-timeouts :spiral_notepad: 

sanjay: @pm_julia @olivia grabbing this. Quick ask: is traffic hitting dedicated pools or hosted?

pm_julia: CS says Dedicated pool id: dp-bridgeflow-07. Throughput spike ~3x. Error rate up to 6% on token streaming endpoints.

olivia: Oncall looking at logs now. Early hypothesis: KV cache misses + long tail requests causing autoscale to lag.

kevin: If autoscale lag, we can temporarily route BridgeFlow to their fallback pool (dp-burst-3) and enable conservative batching while we patch. Will need approval from infra (latency tradeoff).

cs_rafa: We need a concrete timeline to tell the customer. Can the team commit to a mitigation within 30 minutes and a code fix timeline?

sanjay: I can flip routing to dp-burst-3 in ~8 minutes. Preparing a quick route change: 2-step plan — 1) traffic split 80/20 to fallback, 2) increase pool headroom.

olivia: +1 from infra — set temporary batch size to 4 and enable prefix caching override. Snippet to toggle (deploy ops):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.internal.routing/v1/split \
  -d '{"customer":"bridgeflow","primary":"dp-bridgeflow-07","fallback":"dp-burst-3","split":80}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'
```

kevin: I'll open a small hotfix PR to add a KV cache resilience guard and a faster eviction path. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/bridgeflow/compare/fix/fast-kv-evict (draft). ETA for review + merge: 4h.

olivia: Can we also add a temporary inline fallback in the routing layer so requests that hit p99 backend get immediate 503->fallback instead of queuing? I can prod a canary config.

sanjay: Doing the traffic split now. Will post once complete.

pm_julia: Please also update CS and account team once mitigated. They want a one-paragraph customer message.

oncall-bot: Routing change executed by sanjay at 09:33 UTC. Split: 80/20 -> dp-burst-3. Monitoring for 15m.

olivia: Early numbers: error rate down to 1.2%, tail latency reduced ~25% at p99. Still seeing occasional 504s from long prefix requests.

kevin: Hotfix PR is ready for review, test failing in integration but it's expected with the current config. @olivia @sanjay can you give a quick LGTM on the approach?

olivia: I'll review in 10m. Focus on the eviction guard behavior.

pm_julia: CS asked for a target ETA for a full rollback to original pool without fallback. Can we say 6 hours given PR + canary + rollout?

sanjay: 6 hours seems reasonable. We'll aim for a progressive rollback after validation windows. If issues recur, we'll maintain split and work on deeper root cause.

cs_rafa: Noted — I'll tell the customer: short-term mitigation applied (80/20 fallback), monitoring continues, expected full resolution ETA ~6h. They want updates every 60 minutes or earlier if status changes.

kevin: After the hotfix merges, plan: canary (5%) for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% if stable. I'll include a rollback flag.

olivia: One more dependency: the kv-sharder change in infra might affect eviction behavior. @infra-lead can we get eyes? If they block, we'll keep fallback longer.

pm_julia: Thanks team. Owners: sanjay (routing/fallback), kevin (hotfix PR & rollout), olivia (monitoring & canary), cs_rafa (customer comms). I'll update incident ticket and ping exec support if SLA breach looks likely.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2147 updated. Next update requested by 10:33 UTC. :alarm_clock:
